text_en: Jack Selby, head of venture capital firm Copper Sky, believes Anthropic's highly anticipated large IPO could mark the peak of the AI investment boom and could trigger a cascading market pullback once the initial lock-up period ends. "If Anthropic's IPO performs poorly, it could very likely become a key factor in a large-scale correction in the AI market ahead," Selby said in a media interview on Wednesday. "Imagine if the IPO of this most anticipated AI company came in far below its expected valuation—what would happen after the lock-up period ends?"
